svg.title: DNA problems, repair jobs
svg.desc: Four uncoiled DNA ladders show an altered base, a bulky adduct, an A/G copying mismatch and a gap through both strands. Arrows identify selected repair jobs, not exclusive pathway assignments. A separate damage-sensing protein signals to a pause symbol; repair outcome requires checking the DNA.
svg.metadata: Original code-authored SVG; image model null; creation source commit null; proposal only.
svg.text: A signal is a separate question
A warning does not show the repair outcome.
